title: A Comprehensive Evaluation on Quantization Techniques for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2507.17417v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For large language models (LLMs), post-training quantization (PTQ) significantly reduces memory and computational overhead. Despite rapid advancements, existing papers often lack experiments on the same ground. In addition, since quantization solutions typically contain multiple components, it is important to analyze the connections among numerous existing methods to gain an in-depth understanding of this field. To bridge these gaps, we conduct an up-to-date and extensive review of the state-of-the-art methods and perform comprehensive evaluations of low-bit quantization on representative text-only LLMs on the same ground to ensure fair comparisons. To our knowledge, this fair and extensive investigation remains critically important yet significantly underexplored in the research community. To better understand the connections, we first decouple published quantization into two steps: pre-quantization transformation to reduce outliers

translated_title: 大语言模型量化技术的综合评估
translated_abstract: 对于大语言模型（LLMs），训练后量化显著降低了内存和计算开销。尽管该领域发展迅速，现有论文往往缺乏在相同基准下的实验。此外，由于量化方案通常包含多个组件，分析众多现有方法之间的联系对于深入理解这一领域至关重要。为了弥补这些空白，我们对最先进的方法进行了最新且广泛的综述，并在相同基准下对具有代表性的纯文本大语言模型进行了低比特量化的全面评估，以确保公平比较。据我们所知，这种公平且广泛的调查研究仍然至关重要，但在研究界却明显探索不足。为了更好地理解各方法之间的联系，我们首先将已发表的量化方法解耦为两个步骤：用于减少离群值的预量化变换
tldr: 本文对大语言模型的低比特训练后量化技术进行了最新、广泛且公平的综合评估与综述，并通过将量化方法解耦为多个步骤来深入分析现有方法之间的联系。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an up-to-date, extensive, and fair comprehensive evaluation of low-bit post-training quantization techniques for LLMs, analyzing the connections among existing methods by decoupling quantization into distinct steps.
